name: 60636 · Chicago, IL
findings: ZIP 60636 (Chicago) has 171 nonprofit organizations. 45 of them (26%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 39 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (64% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 60636 (Chicago) has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.
